title: Smart Ecommerce System Setup: The Complete 2026 Tech Stack Blueprint
excerpt: Build a complete ecommerce tech stack from scratch — Shopify, Klaviyo, Rebuy, Smile.io, Gorgias, and ShipStation with exact pricing and a 6-week deployment timeline.
content:
## Why a Coherent Tech Stack Matters

Most ecommerce brands don't plan their tech stack — they bolt on tools one at a time as problems arise. An email problem? Add Klaviyo. A support problem? Add Gorgias. A retention problem? Add Smile.io. Within 18 months, the average store runs 15 disconnected tools with overlapping features, conflicting data, and different login systems. This patchwork costs more than a planned stack and creates operational friction that slows every decision.

This article builds a complete ecommerce system from the foundation up — storefront, marketing, retention, support, and fulfilment — using proven tools with transparent pricing. Every tool here has native integrations with the others, so your data flows cleanly without middleware. The total monthly cost for a mid-market store is roughly $418–$723/month, compared to $800–$1,400/month for an unplanned stack that covers the same functions with redundancy.

## Shopify Plus — The Storefront Foundation

Shopify remains the most practical storefront for DTC brands, and Shopify Plus ($2,300/month) is the version designed for growth. It includes unlimited staff accounts, 10 inventory locations, Shopify Flow automation, and priority support. The Plus plan also unlocks Checkout Extensibility — custom post-purchase offers, one-click upsells, and branded checkout pages without the 0.5%–2% transaction fee that standard Shopify customers pay.

For brands with less than $500K annual revenue, Shopify's Business plan at $39/month is sufficient. It includes a custom domain, gift cards, and 5 inventory locations. The Advanced plan at $399/month adds advanced report builder and third-party calculated shipping rates. Most stores start on Business or Advanced and upgrade to Plus once they cross $1M in revenue or need Shopify Flow's automation capabilities. Either way, Shopify's 400+ pre-built app integrations mean you can connect the rest of your stack without custom development.

## Klaviyo — Email and SMS Marketing Engine

Klaviyo is the default email marketing platform for Shopify stores for good reason: its AI-powered predictive analytics model customer behaviour better than any competitor. The platform's built-in machine learning scores every contact by predicted lifetime value, likelihood to purchase, and churn risk — so you can segment email and SMS campaigns by actual buying propensity rather than arbitrary tags.

Klaviyo pricing scales with contact count. The Free plan supports up to 250 contacts and 500 emails per month — enough to test the platform. The Email plan starts at $20/month for 501–1,000 contacts with 25X their contact count in monthly email sends. The Email + SMS plan at $35/month adds SMS credits ($0.0079 per segment for US/CA). For a store with 10,000 contacts, expect to pay roughly $60–$150/month depending on email volume. The platform's deep Shopify integration syncs orders, products, and browsing behaviour in real time, so segments like "abandoned cart in last 4 hours" or "bought product X and hasn't reordered in 45 days" work automatically.

## Rebuy and Smile.io — Retention, Personalization, and Loyalty

Rebuy replaces multiple personalization tools by handling product recommendations, on-site merchandising, and post-purchase offers in one platform. Its AI engine analyses every visitor's browsing and purchase history across sessions, then serves personalised product carousels, cart upsells, and checkout offers. Brands using Rebuy see average order value increases of 12–18% within the first 30 days. Pricing starts at $79/month for the Growth plan (5,000 monthly orders). The Advanced plan at $199/month (15,000 orders) adds A/B testing on recommendation widgets and custom CSS. Rebuy installs as a Shopify app and goes from install to first live widget in under an hour.

Smile.io covers the loyalty side — points-for-purchases, VIP tiers, referral program tracking, and social engagement rewards. The AI analyses purchase patterns to suggest optimal point earning rates and reward thresholds for your margins. Smile.io's Free plan supports unlimited members. The Starter plan at $49/month adds VIP tiers and referral rewards. The Growth plan at $199/month adds automated reward suggestions and integrations with Gorgias (agents adjust loyalty points from the ticket view) and Klaviyo (personalised points-balance emails). Combined, Rebuy and Smile.io cost $128–$398/month and handle personalization + retention without overlapping features.

## Gorgias — Support Hub and ShipStation — Fulfillment

Gorgias connects email, live chat, phone, and social media DMs into a single inbox, then layers AI on top to suggest replies, auto-tag tickets, and surface order data. When a customer messages "Where's my order?", Gorgias pulls tracking info from Shopify and generates a draft response with the carrier link and estimated delivery date — the agent approves or edits and sends with one click. Gorgias pricing: Starter at $60/month (350 tickets/month), Growth at $360/month (2,000 tickets/month with AI auto-reply), Pro at $900/month (unlimited tickets, custom analytics, and API access). For a store with 500–1,500 monthly support tickets, the Growth plan is the sweet spot. The AI auto-reply feature handles 30–50% of inquiries without human intervention — shipping status, return policies, order modification requests — which lets a single support agent handle the workload of three.

ShipStation automates the post-checkout fulfilment process: rate comparison across USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL, label printing in batches, tracking number syncing back to Shopify, and branded tracking pages. The AI features include intelligent carrier selection (automatically choose the cheapest carrier meeting the delivery window) and address validation that reduces failed deliveries by 5–8%. Pricing starts at $9.99/month for the Bronze plan (50 shipments/month). The Silver plan at $29.99/month (500 shipments) covers most early-stage stores. The Gold plan at $59.99/month (3,000 shipments) adds batch label printing and automated carrier rules. A store doing 1,000–2,000 monthly orders should budget $30–$60/month for shipping software alone. ShipStation's direct integration with Shopify means orders appear automatically, and tracking emails can be triggered through Klaviyo rather than ShipStation for brand consistency.

## 6-Week Deployment Timeline

Week 1–2 — Foundation: Launch Shopify with your theme integrated, domain configured, and payment gateway active. Install Klaviyo and configure the Shopify integration so order and browse data syncs. Create your first 3 flows: abandoned cart, welcome series, and post-purchase thank-you. Budget: $39–$2,300/month for Shopify + $20–$150/month for Klaviyo.

Week 3–4 — Growth Tools: Install Rebuy ($79–$199/month) and configure product recommendations for the product page, cart page, and checkout. Set up Smile.io ($49/month) with basic points and a 3-tier VIP structure. Connect both to Klaviyo so loyalty data and recommendations inform email personalization. Week 5–6 — Operations: Deploy Gorgias ($60–$360/month) and connect your Shopify, Klaviyo, and Smile.io accounts. Configure the AI auto-reply for shipping and returns queries. Set up ShipStation ($30–$60/month) with carrier accounts and automated label printing. By week 6, every customer touchpoint — browse, purchase, post-purchase, support, shipping — is connected in a single data loop without manual data entry or CSV exports.
